title: Corner Detection
text: Calculate corner metric matrix and find corners in images, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output} sets Block output Corner; {Method} sets the corner detection method Harris corner, {Sensitivity factor (0<k<0.25)}, {Coefficients for separable smoothing filter} sets the filter coefficients fspecial, {Intensity comparison threshold} sets the intensity threshold, {Maximum angle to be considered a corner (in degrees)} sets the maximum corner angle, {Maximum number of corners}, {Minimum metric value that indicates a corner} sets the minimum corner metric, {Neighborhood size}, {Output variable size signal} sets the variable size signal and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I
ports.summary: Input image matrix of intensity values

params.name: Method
params.values: Corner detection method Harris corner detection (Harris & Stephens) (default) | Minimum eigenvalue (Shi & Tomasi) | Local intensity comparison (Rosten & Drummond)

params.name: Maximum angle to be considered a corner (in degrees)
Output
params.values: Block output Corner location (default) | Corner location and metric matrix | Metric matrix

params.name: Minimum metric value that indicates a corner
Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
